resources.string: Lets Focus see which app is open, so it can act on the apps you choose to watch, and only those: the line at the top of the screen during a sit, App Time\'s block screen, the prayer reminder and the gray screen. If you turn on website blocking, it also reads your browser\'s address bar to close the sites you blocked. Banking and every other app you haven\'t added are left alone, and Focus never reads or keeps anything on your screen.
